steps: Open the official monthly reports page and choose the period you need. June 2026 was the latest dated monthly link found in this index when checked; this does not establish archive completeness or posting dates.

Start with the tested June 2026 PDF. Text extraction worked on its first 12 pages; the tested General Fund Revenue row is on PDF viewer page 7. Preserve the document link, period and PDF page with every extracted value.

For annual budgets and audits, use the Annual City Budgets & Audits page. The tested 2025–2026 adopted budget PDF is separate from proposed budgets and audit documents; do not substitute one report type for another.

Run the finance verification script from a clone of this repository after installing pypdf==5.9.0: python3 scripts/verify-finance.py. Or run the shared validation workflow with the finance option. It discovers report links, downloads one monthly report and one adopted budget, and inspects at most 12 pages of each.

The script writes verification/finance-row-sample.json containing one Real Estate revenue row, its source, period and PDF page. It checks percentage-of-budget and forecast-minus-budget arithmetic. This is a repository-generated example, not a city-published dataset or a complete extraction.

Use the finance extraction guide to extend the sample. Normalize broken text and multiline headings, preserve parentheses as negative amounts, distinguish monthly and cumulative values, and check rows and totals against the PDF before using a table in a product.
Preserve original report links and PDF page references when presenting figures. Confirm reuse and redistribution terms before republishing copied documents or extracted tables.
contact: Office of Policy, Management and Grants; data-maintenance contact not confirmed.
limitations: On October 6, 2026, GitHub's runner retrieved both official indexes, downloaded the June 2026 monthly PDF (59 pages) and the 2025–2026 adopted budget PDF (503 pages), and extracted text from the first 12 pages of each. Browser-tool failures do not establish that these official downloads are unavailable.

The inspected monthly pages had substantial extractable text; automatic OCR was not needed for that sample. Other pages and documents have not been assessed. Some extracted words and headings lose spacing or characters, so plain text is not automatically a trustworthy table.

One Real Estate revenue row on PDF viewer page 7 was extracted into JSON. Its displayed percentage and forecast-minus-budget formula reconciled. Full report totals, other revenue rows, expenditure tables, annual budget tables and cross-period consistency have not been validated.

The latest dated monthly index link found was June 2026. The index contained 90 document links and the annual index 65; link counts do not prove complete monthly coverage, report freshness or successful downloads of every file.
No official finance API, CSV or spreadsheet export has been verified. The repository-generated JSON example is not a maintained city dataset.

Actual collections, approved budgets, year-end forecasts, monthly amounts and year-to-date cumulative totals are different quantities. Preserve report period, column meanings and sign conventions; do not sum cumulative totals across months.
The adopted-budget front matter describes different accounting bases for different funds. This check does not establish how monthly figures reconcile with audited financial statements.
The sample PDF covers include rights notices. Reuse and redistribution permissions, refresh responsibility and a published maintenance contact remain unconfirmed.
